errors.evidence: The description incorrectly expands the acronym БДС (GVA, Gross Value Added) as 'брутен вътрешен продукт' (GDP, Gross Domestic Product). The correct term is 'брутна добавена стойност'.
The description claims there are additional gridlines at every 1,000 units on the y-axis, but the chart only has major gridlines at every 5,000 units.
The description fails to mention that the blue line is a dashed line, which is a key visual distinction from the solid orange line.
The description states that the blue line ends at 27,338.8 in 2018. According to the chart, the value for the blue line in 2018 is 26,017.2; the value 27,338.8 corresponds to the year 2017.

errors.text_span: и по-силно спадане между 2016 и 2017 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims the drop for the blue line between 2016 (28092.1) and 2017 (27338.8) is stronger than the drop between 2008 (15324.8) and 2009 (13282.9). The 2008-2009 drop is approximately -2042, while the 2016-2017 drop is approximately -753. The statement is factually incorrect.

The description correctly states the final value for the orange line (25,356.0 in 2018) but swaps the series. This value belongs to the orange line, not the blue line which was the subject of the preceding part of the sentence.

errors.text_span: Втората линия, означена с оранжево... показва общо нарастване до 25 356,0 в 2018 г.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly assigns the ending value of 25,356.0 (which belongs to the orange line) to the blue line described in the previous sentence. It then re-states the same value for the orange line, creating confusion and swapping the end values of the two series. The blue line ends at 26017.2, and the orange line ends at 25356.0.
